tickets.summary: K-3401 NDE bearing vibration rising 2.1→4.6 mm/s over 6 weeks and still climbing on single-train export compressor with no spare.
tickets.recommended_action: Engage rotating equipment specialist to diagnose rising NDE vibration, inspect bearing/rotor and balance/alignment as needed; correct cause then run-up and verify vibration back near baseline.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Rising unplateaued vibration trend indicates active degradation but still below alarm and no trip reported.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Single-train export compressor with no spare; failure forces recycle and production cut within an hour, giving severe operational impact.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v1: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=6, I=8, base=8, final=8.

tickets.summary: Firewater pump B failed first-attempt start in weekly test, only starting after ~8 s with 22.8 V batteries and known recurring start issues, leaving firewater availability reliant on an underperforming duty pump.
tickets.recommended_action: Replace/charge starting batteries and inspect starting circuit; verify first-attempt auto start meets criterion; log impairment/deviation and restore firewater availability Check deviation log Confirm FW-8101 delivers design pressure/flow

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Demand start failed on first attempt in a functional test, confirming current unreliability. Recurrent starting issues and low battery voltage indicate high risk of repeat failure on next demand despite eventual second-start success.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this SCE would remove one of two firewater pumps; loss of demand start disables a primary protection layer against major fires. Redundancy is uncertain because the partner shows low discharge pressure, so full firewater capacity may not be available.

tickets.summary: Wet-insulated low-point on PL-1002 shows CUI with UT 6.2 mm versus 7.4 mm minimum; below allowable wall on a live 6" hydrocarbon flowline, indicating active loss of containment margin.
tickets.recommended_action: Isolate the affected spool, perform FFS and replace or sleeve the thin section, renew dry insulation, then repeat UT to confirm restored wall thickness meets minimum

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Local wall thickness is below the minimum allowable at a wet, low-point location, indicating active corrosion under insulation and reduced margin though no leak yet. Progression likely to continue without intervention.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the live hydrocarbon production flowline would release wellhead pressure with no redundancy, giving severe safety and operational consequence.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v1: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=8, I=8, base=8, final=8.

tickets.summary: 2oo3 gas detector head in compression module failed two 50% LEL bump tests while the other two heads responded, leaving detection margin lost on that channel.
tickets.recommended_action: Replace/repair failed detector head and bump-test the 2oo3 group to confirm response; raise required deviation record and close out on restoration. Check deviation log

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Head failed repeated bump tests, so its required detection function is currently unavailable.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this head alone leaves 2oo3 gas detection still functional but without margin in a compression module SCE; loss of remaining heads would defeat detection. Impact is a protection degradation with remaining capability.

tickets.summary: Main hoist rope has 6 broken wires per lay (discard at 10) and poor lubrication at max radius; crane remains usable but degradation could reach discard soon with no spare crane
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect entire hoist rope, relubricate, and replace if any section meets discard limits; retension and function test crane after work

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Rope damage and poor lubrication show active degradation but broken wires remain below discard criteria and other components are satisfactory; function not yet failed but progression risk exists given moderate reliability and continued use.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of the only pedestal crane would halt supply boat offloads causing significant operational disruption within days; no redundancy available but consequence is logistical, not a protection layer or life safety.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v1: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=6, I=6, base=6, final=6.

tickets.summary: Corrosion inhibitor pump has tripped three times this month and injection has been intermittent for ~10 days, leaving corrosion protection off-spec and risking downstream steel corrosion.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect and repair/replace pump (likely diaphragm), restore steady inhibitor injection, then verify discharge pressure/flow meets requirement. Check deviation log

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Third low-pressure trip this month with ten days of intermittent injection shows the pump is not maintaining required inhibitor delivery, indicating current function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: No redundancy; loss of corrosion inhibitor accelerates downstream carbon steel corrosion within weeks, creating delayed integrity risk though no immediate production loss.

tickets.recommended_action: Structural engineer to size crack, install temporary support if required, and execute weld repair; confirm MPI/UT and structural acceptance after repair. Check deviation log entry

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: MPI-confirmed 45 mm crack at a primary connection shows active structural damage; failure has not occurred but progression risk is high without mitigation.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of a cracked primary brace weld on safety critical cellar deck support with no redundancy could compromise structural integrity and safety protection.

tickets.summary: Coating breakdown and rust staining under cellar deck between C2–C5 on primary support steel; historically cosmetic, no section loss reported but SCE so confirm thickness and restore coating.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect affected spans for section loss (UT/close visual), then repair/renew coating to arrest corrosion. UT/visual to confirm no section loss

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Visual coating breakdown only, previously seen and usually cosmetic. No section loss or cracking reported; structural reliability high. Near-term function loss unlikely though corrosion may progress if untreated.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Primary support steelwork with no redundancy; failure would compromise structural integrity and a safety critical element. Consequence of loss is severe despite cosmetic nature of current defect.

tickets.summary: TR pressurisation test only 27 Pa vs 50 Pa requirement; fan runs but envelope leaks, so TR cannot maintain required overpressure.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect dampers and door seals, rectify leakage, verify damper/fan operation, retest TR pressurisation to >=50 Pa and reinstate. Check deviation log

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Function test shows TR cannot maintain required overpressure now; required function failed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: TR pressurisation SCE with no redundancy; loss allows gas ingress during an event, affecting personnel shelter.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Lifeboat unavailable removes an evacuation craft; evacuation capacity may fall below required POB if standby is not available. Safety critical with no confirmed alternative.

tickets.summary: PSV-3420 compressor discharge relief valve tag corroded/illegible but register shows Mar 2025 recertification and valve condition appears sound; documentation defect only.
tickets.recommended_action: Replace corroded certification tag and confirm register entry; verify tag legibility after replacement.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Recent recertification and good observed condition with only an illegible tag; no indication of functional degradation and high reliability score.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Valve provides sole overpressure protection on compressor discharge with no redundancy; failure would remove a safety critical protection layer with severe consequence.

tickets.recommended_action: Investigate low discharge pressure; verify test line valves and suction/discharge path, inspect pump for wear; restore to achieve 11 barg; retest weekly start to confirm duty pressure Check deviation log Measure firewater flow/pressure at header

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Function test showed delivery below design pressure, indicating the pump cannot currently meet required duty. This is a confirmed failure of required function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Firewater pump A underdelivers pressure; paired pump B recently showed starting unreliability, so redundancy is weakened. Loss of this pump risks impaired firewater supply, a safety protection layer with major-accident exposure.

tickets.summary: K-3401 second-stage discharge lagging/cladding is loose and flapping; no process effect but poses a dropped-object hazard if left unsecured.
tickets.recommended_action: Refix and secure loose lagging/cladding on K-3401 2nd stage discharge, remove or reattach any loose sections, check area for damage and eliminate dropped-object risk; verify integrity afterwards

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Loose cladding presents dropped-object risk but no indication of process or mechanical degradation; function currently unaffected. Progression to function loss unlikely in near term if secured.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Single-train export compressor with no standby; loss stops export within an hour. Lagging failure itself is minor but if it caused damage leading to trip, consequence is major operational loss.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v1: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=2, I=8, base=7, final=7.
